from pylabrobot.liquid_handling.backends import (

# Import common PyLabRobot resources.

from pylabrobot.resources import Plate, TipRack, Well


async def protocol(lh: LiquidHandler):
    """
    Main protocol function for PyLabRobot.

    This function contains all the liquid handling operations.
    The AI Agent will replace the placeholder below with generated protocol logic.

    Args:
        lh (LiquidHandler): The liquid handler instance for performing operations
    """
    
    # [AGENT_CODE_STUB]
    # ======================================================================
    # Simulation-ready protocol: reagent pre-load + sample transfer
    #
    # FIX APPLIED (GeneralError: deprecated backend):

    #   backend must be created as:

    #       from pylabrobot.liquid_handling.backends import (

    # ======================================================================

    try:
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        # 1. Retrieve pre-configured deck resources
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        tip_rack = lh.get_resource("tip_rack_50ul")
        source_plate = lh.get_resource("source_plate")
        destination_plate = lh.get_resource("destination_plate")
        reagent_trough = lh.get_resource("reagent_trough")
        print("Resources loaded: tip_rack_50ul, source_plate, "
              "destination_plate, reagent_trough")

        TRANSFER_VOL_UL = 40   # uL per sample transfer (fits 50 uL tips)
        REAGENT_VOL_UL = 45    # uL reagent pre-load per well

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        # 2. Reagent pre-load: trough A1 -> destination well A1
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack["A1"])
        await lh.aspirate(reagent_trough["A1"], vols=[REAGENT_VOL_UL])
        await lh.dispense(destination_plate["A1"], vols=[REAGENT_VOL_UL])
        await lh.drop_tips()
        print(f"Step 1 OK: dispensed {REAGENT_VOL_UL} uL reagent into "
              "destination_plate['A1']")

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        # 3. Sample transfer: source column 1 -> destination column 1
        #    One fresh tip per well, taken from tip rack column 2
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        src_column = source_plate.column(1)
        dst_column = destination_plate.column(1)
        tips_column = tip_rack.column(2)

        for src_well, dst_well, tip in zip(src_column, dst_column, tips_column):
            await lh.pick_up_tips(tip)
            await lh.aspirate(src_well, vols=[TRANSFER_VOL_UL])
            await lh.dispense(dst_well, vols=[TRANSFER_VOL_UL])
            await lh.drop_tips()
            print(f"Step 2 OK: transferred {TRANSFER_VOL_UL} uL "
                  f"{src_well.name} -> {dst_well.name}")

        print(f"All {len(src_column)} sample transfers completed "
              f"({TRANSFER_VOL_UL} uL each).")
        print("--- PROTOCOL_SUCCESS ---")

    except Exception as err:
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Simulation failure report: print error details for diagnostics,
        # then re-raise so the failure propagates to the caller.
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        print("--- PROTOCOL_FAILED ---")
        print(f"Error type    : {type(err).__name__}")
        print(f"Error message : {err}")
        raise

async def main():
    """
    Main execution function that sets up the liquid handler and runs the protocol.
    """
    # Initialize the liquid handler with a simulation backend
    lh = LiquidHandler(backend=ChatterBoxBackend(), deck_layout=None)
    
    try:
        # Setup the liquid handler
        await lh.setup()
        
        # Run the protocol
        await protocol(lh)
        
        print("✅ Protocol execution completed successfully!")
        
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Protocol execution failed: {e}")
        raise
    finally:
        # Always stop the liquid handler to clean up resources
        try:
            await lh.stop()
        except Exception as cleanup_error:
            print(f"⚠️ Warning: Failed to clean up liquid handler: {cleanup_error}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    """
    Entry point for running the protocol.
    """
    print("🚀 Starting PyLabRobot Protocol Execution...")
    asyncio.run(main())
